messages:
anya: Heads-up  Large regulated customer (RegulaCo) pushed for a pilot with SOC2-aligned audit logs + tenant-level retention rules. They want to start 2027-02-10. This impacts our MVP timeline.
kevin: ugh. audit-grade logging and retention controls were targeted for v1. delivering earlier will eat up infra cycles.
lucy: engineering options: A) fast-path: ship a limited audit log layer (write-only, immutable events) + per-tenant retention toggle; B) delay audit logs and offer a monitored trial under NDA. Option A is ~2.5w of eng + 1w QA.
jason: product take: RegulaCo is strategic; earlier pilot could convert to enterprise contract. willing to accept cuts to noncore UX to accelerate. what can we safely defer?
lucy: candidate cuts: defer personalization UI, defer embeddings autotune, postpone in-console deep cost breakdowns. These free up front-end + infra cycles.
sarah-legal: legal note: if we enable elevated logging, we need an explicit data-processing addendum and retention SLA in the pilot T&Cs. Also need sign-off on immutable log storage and access controls.
anya: tradeoff proposal: accept fast-path (A). Scope: immutable audit log + tenant retention controls (EU/US), restrict pilot to single EU region for RegulaCo, defer personalization + embeddings autotune to v1, and offer a timeboxed pilot (Feb10Feb24). Approve?
kevin: ops concern: immutable logs increase storage; propose a compressed, write-once archive that auto-expires per tenant. Also require a manual emergency purge flow under legal control.
lucy: engineering will surface basic log events (auth, model-pin, deploys, config changes, request metadata) — no full payload capture. That keeps privacy risk low and reduces volume.
jason: how do we preserve debugging capability if we strip payloads? support needs traces.
kevin: keep lightweight traces (ids, latency, error codes) linked to audit events. Full payloads only archived for a short window with legal-approved access.
sarah-legal: i'll draft the DPA addendum + retention SLA and the emergency purge process. Need product to confirm which events are captured.
anya: risk controls & milestones: 1) engineer spike complete by 1/12 (validate write-once store), 2) api + retention toggle PR by 1/24, 3) QA + compliance review by 2/02, 4) pilot start 2/10. If any milestone slips >48h we rebaseline pilot.
lucy: ETA ok if we reassign one runtime eng from embeddings to audit work this sprint. otherwise slips.
jason: product ok to reassign. we'll flag embeddings autotune deferred to v1 and note cost impact to the customer.
ops-bot: pipeline scheduled: "pilot/regulaco/audit-fastpath" deploy 2027-02-08 03:00 UTC. status: queued.
anya: action items: lucy - spike & arch notes (due 2027-01-12); kevin - storage & purge runbook (due 2027-01-15); sarah-legal - DPA + retention SLA draft (due 2027-01-18); jason - customer-facing pilot caveat doc (due 2027-01-18). I'll consolidate and send to RegulaCo once legal reviews.
kevin: will also add SLO gates and a rollback plan: p99 < 700ms, error <0.5%, auto-fallback to hosted variant if breach persists >30m.
anya: thanks. If anyone hits blockers escalate here. We should be conservative on promises given compliance work upstream. :thumbsup:
